overview.welcomeDescription: Everything you need to learn and master the ERP system. Watch videos, follow step-by-step guides or explore FAQs.

modules.title: 1. Getting Started
modules.name: Getting Started
modules.description: Learn the basics and get familiar with the system.

lessons.title: System Overview and Dashboard Tour
lessons.description: Get an overview of the dashboard and understand the main modules in Prince Constructions ERP.

steps.title: Accessing the Main Navigation Shell
steps.content: Click the sidebar on the left to expand or collapse modules. Use ⌘B / Ctrl+B anytime to toggle sidebar density.

steps.title: Switching Active Site Scope
steps.content: Click the site dropdown in the top bar to filter telemetry, site diaries, and stock balance to a specific location.

steps.title: Interpreting Dashboard KPI Tiles
steps.content: Review live site network metrics: Active Sites, Material Indents, Monthly Running Bills, and Cash Balances.

lessons.title: How to Login and Reset Password
lessons.description: Learn secure sign-in, role switching with demo credentials, and password recovery via work email.

steps.title: Navigating to Login Screen
steps.content: Open the ERP URL. Enter your corporate email and password or click any Demo Role quick-badge for testing.

steps.title: Requesting Password Reset
steps.content: If you forgot your password, click 'Forgot password?' on the login card, enter your registered email, and follow the instructions.

lessons.title: Update Profile and Preferences
lessons.description: Configure your display name, notification preferences, dark/light themes, and offline cache settings.

steps.title: Opening Settings
steps.content: Click the avatar or Settings gear icon in the lower sidebar navigation.

steps.title: Setting Active Firm and Default Site
steps.content: Select your primary engineering firm and working site to automatically scope forms upon creation.

lessons.title: Navigation and Module Overview
lessons.description: Master accordion menus, quick-action flyouts in collapsed mode, and breadcrumb trails.

steps.title: Exploring Module Sections
steps.content: Notice 9 distinct engineering groups: Organization, Project Management, Procurement, Inventory, Contractor & Billing, Accounting & Finance, Communication, Reports, and Settings.

steps.title: Using Flyout Menus in Mini Mode
steps.content: When sidebar is collapsed, clicking any section icon reveals a floating contextual action menu.

lessons.title: Mobile Access (PWA) Introduction
lessons.description: Install Prince Constructions ERP directly on Android, iPhone, or iPad for complete offline site support.

steps.title: Opening Install Prompt
steps.content: Click 'Install App' at the bottom of the sidebar or the banner in your mobile browser.

steps.title: Using Offline Mode on Site
steps.content: When cellular reception is lost, the ERP automatically switches to local IndexedDB storage and queues drafts.

lessons.title: Multi-Site Switching & Permissions
lessons.description: How supervisors and project directors switch between multi-location construction sites.

lessons.title: Global Search with ⌘K Quick Shortcuts
lessons.description: Instant keyboard navigation across projects, vouchers, materials, and contractor contacts.

lessons.title: Offline Data Sync & Local Storage
lessons.description: Detailed mechanics of how DPR drafts and photo evidence sync safely when reconnecting.

modules.title: 2. Organization Setup
modules.name: Organization Setup
modules.description: Establish legal companies, construction projects, geographical sites, and team roles.

lessons.title: Creating Company Firms & Legal Entities
lessons.description: Configure company legal name, GSTIN number, registered state, and PAN details for billing.

steps.title: Access Firms & Companies Register
steps.content: Navigate to Organization -> Firms & Companies. Click '+ New Firm' in the top action bar.

steps.title: Fill Legal & Tax Identifiers
steps.content: Input legal trade name, 15-digit GSTIN, state code, PAN number, and corporate billing address.

steps.title: Save & Set Default Firm
steps.content: Click 'Save Record'. The firm is now available for all invoice headers and purchase orders.

lessons.title: Setting Up Projects & Site Locations
lessons.description: Define parent civil projects, contract values, target completion dates, and physical site locations.

steps.title: Create Project Record
steps.content: Navigate to Organization -> Projects. Enter project code, client reference, estimated budget, and start/finish dates.

steps.title: Link Geo-Fenced Site Locations
steps.content: Go to Organization -> Sites / Locations. Associate each site with a parent project and capture latitude/longitude.

lessons.title: Adding Users & Role-Based Access Controls
lessons.description: Assign owner, project manager, site supervisor, storekeeper, and purchase officer roles with fine-grained rights.

lessons.title: Client Master Setup & Contact Directory
lessons.description: Register government agencies, private developers, billing addresses, and payment terms.

lessons.title: Contractor Registry & Compliance Documents
lessons.description: Enroll subcontractors, trade specializations, PAN/GST certificates, and bank account details.

modules.title: 3. Project Management
modules.name: Project Management
modules.description: Track site progress, daily DPR site diaries, task activities, and milestone budgets.

lessons.title: Project Dashboard & Telemetry Overview
lessons.description: Monitor overall project health, physical vs financial progress curves, and open roadblocks.

steps.title: Open Project Dashboard
steps.content: Go to Project Management -> Project Dashboard. Select your active project in the header filter.

steps.title: Examine Physical vs Financial S-Curves
steps.content: Compare cumulative certified work against planned baseline budgets and time elapsed.

lessons.title: Creating Daily Site Diary (DPR) Entries
lessons.description: Record daily site weather, labour headcount (skilled/unskilled), machinery hours, and work executed.

steps.title: Open Site Diary Register
steps.content: Navigate to Project Management -> Site Diary and click '+ New DPR Entry'.

steps.title: Record Weather & Site Conditions
steps.content: Specify sunny, cloudy, or rain interruption hours, and temperature.

steps.title: Log Labour & Equipment Deployed
steps.content: Enter counts for carpenters, masons, bar benders, helpers, and excavator/transit mixer hours.

steps.title: Document Output & Submit
steps.content: Summarize BOQ work completed (e.g. 85 m³ raft concreting) and submit for Project Manager approval.

lessons.title: Geotagged Site Photo & GPS Evidence Logging
lessons.description: Capture tamper-evident photos embedding device coordinates, accuracy radius, and server timestamp.

lessons.title: Work Breakdown Structure & Activity Tasks
lessons.description: Organize excavation, PCC, RCC, masonry, and finishing into manageable milestone tasks.

lessons.title: Budget Allocation vs Actual Milestone Tracking
lessons.description: Compare sanctioned estimate line items against cumulative procurement and labour billing.

modules.title: 4. Procurement
modules.name: Procurement
modules.description: Streamline requisition from sites, quotation approvals, purchase orders, and goods receipt.

lessons.title: Raising Material Requisitions from Mobile/Site
lessons.description: How site engineers request cement, TMT steel, coarse aggregate, and pipe fittings directly from the field.

steps.title: Navigate to Material Requests
steps.content: Go to Procurement -> Material Requests and click '+ New Request'.

steps.title: Select Site and Item Lines
steps.content: Choose the receiving site, urgency level (Normal/Urgent), and required-by date.

steps.title: Add Quantities and Specifications
steps.content: Add item line items (e.g. 500 Bags OPC 53 Cement) and submit into the approval queue.

lessons.title: Approving Indents & Generating Purchase Orders
lessons.description: Purchase officer workflow: vendor quotation selection, GST rate configuration, and PO generation.

lessons.title: Gate Inward & Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
lessons.description: Storekeeper inspection, vehicle number entry, weighbridge slips, and accepting inward quantity.

lessons.title: Three-Way Matching: PO vs Challan vs Bill
lessons.description: Verifying delivery challan quantities and vendor tax invoice against approved purchase order terms.

modules.title: 5. Inventory Management
modules.name: Inventory Management
modules.description: Real-time site stock tracking, store issues to subcontractors, inter-site transfers, and stock audits.
modules.comingSoonMessage: Training Module will add soon. Our content team is actively creating high-definition video walkthroughs and step-by-step documentation for inventory registers.

modules.name: Contractor & Billing

modules.title: 7. Accounting & Finance
modules.name: Accounting & Finance
modules.description: Complete step-by-step masterclass on double-entry accounting, vouchers, bank reconciliation, TDS, GST, and balance sheets.

lessons.title: Overview of Double-Entry Accounting in Civil ERP
lessons.description: Understand how Prince Constructions ERP maintains automated double-entry ledger postings across all sites, purchase bills, and contractor payments.

steps.title: Understanding Chart of Accounts
steps.content: Learn the 5 top-level heads: Assets (Bank, Cash, Site Inventory, Retention Receivable), Liabilities (Sundry Creditors, Contractor Retention Payable, GST/TDS Payable), Equity, Income (Client Billing), and Expenses (Direct Site Material, Labour, Equipment Hire).

steps.title: Site-Wise Cost Centers
steps.content: Every voucher transaction is tagged with a Site ID and Project ID, allowing automated site-specific Profit & Loss calculation.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Creating Cash & Bank Payment Vouchers
lessons.description: Complete walkthrough of recording payments to vendors, fuel suppliers, petty cash site expenses, and utility bills.

steps.title: Open Voucher Entry Form
steps.content: Go to Accounting & Finance -> Vouchers. Click '+ New Voucher' in the upper-right corner.

steps.title: Select Voucher Type: Payment
steps.content: Choose 'Payment Voucher'. Select your payment account (e.g. 'IDBI Bank Current A/c' or 'Site Petty Cash').

steps.title: Choose Opposing Ledger & Site Allocation
steps.content: Select the beneficiary ledger (e.g. 'Shree Cement Ltd' or 'Site Generator Diesel Expense'). Tag the active construction site.

steps.title: Enter Amount, Reference & Narration
steps.content: Input the transaction amount, cheque / RTGS / UTR reference number, and a detailed narration for audit trail.

steps.title: Post and Print Voucher
steps.content: Click 'Post Voucher'. The debit and credit entries immediately reflect in your Bank Book and General Ledger. Click Print for physical sign-off.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Recording Receipt Vouchers & Client Inflows
lessons.description: How to record mobilization advances, interim client payment certificates, and retention releases from project clients.

steps.title: Create Receipt Voucher
steps.content: Navigate to Accounting & Finance -> Vouchers. Select 'Receipt Voucher' as the type.

steps.title: Debit Bank & Credit Client Ledger
steps.content: Select the receiving bank account. Choose the client account (e.g. 'UP Jal Nigam' or 'NHAI Project Division').

steps.title: Record TDS & GST Withholdings
steps.content: Specify any TDS u/s 194C deducted by client and GST-TDS (2%) to reconcile the net bank deposit with gross certified bill.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Contractor Running Bill Accounting & Deductions
lessons.description: In-depth guide on booking subcontractor RA bills with automatic retention money, advance recovery, and TDS deductions.

steps.title: Select Approved Running Bill
steps.content: Navigate to Contractor & Billing -> Bill Approvals or Vouchers. Open the certified RA bill.

steps.title: Examine Gross vs Net Deductions
steps.content: Gross Work Value: Debit 'Contractor Site Expense'. Deductions: Credit 'Retention Money Payable' (typically 5%), Credit 'Labour Cess' (1%), Credit 'TDS 194C' (1% or 2%).

steps.title: Post Bill to Contractor Payable Ledger
steps.content: The net payable amount is credited to the Subcontractor's Personal Ledger, ready for payment scheduling.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Vendor Purchase Bill Posting & GST ITC Claim
lessons.description: Process material vendor invoices with CGST, SGST, IGST input tax credit allocation and RCM checks.

steps.title: Match Invoice with GRN
steps.content: In Procurement -> Purchase Bills, click '+ New Bill' and attach the Goods Receipt Note (GRN).

steps.title: Verify GST Breakdown
steps.content: Confirm taxable value and GST rates (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%). The system debits 'Input CGST' and 'Input SGST' / 'Input IGST'.

steps.title: Post to Sundry Creditors
steps.content: Approve bill. The vendor ledger updates with net payable and payment due date.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Journal Vouchers for Site Adjustments & Contra
lessons.description: How to record depreciation on site machinery, prepaid insurances, inter-bank cash withdrawals, and year-end accruals.

steps.title: Open Journal Voucher Form
steps.content: Go to Accounting & Finance -> Vouchers and click '+ New Voucher'. Select 'Journal Voucher' or 'Contra Voucher'.

steps.title: Debit Expense or Asset & Credit Contra Account
steps.content: For depreciation: Debit 'Depreciation - Site Plant & Machinery', Credit 'Accumulated Depreciation'. For inter-bank: Debit Destination Bank, Credit Source Bank.

steps.title: Enter Site Tag & Audit Narration
steps.content: Tag the specific construction site and record clear reference notes explaining the adjustment.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS)
lessons.description: Match bank passbook statements with ERP book entries, clear unpresented cheques, and record bank charges.

steps.title: Access BRS Reconciliation Screen
steps.content: Navigate to Accounting & Finance -> Cash & Bank -> BRS. Select your bank account and statement cut-off date.

steps.title: Match Cleared Cheques & RTGS Credits
steps.content: Mark payments that have cleared the bank. Compare transaction reference numbers (UTR) against bank statement.

steps.title: Record Bank Interest & Service Charges
steps.content: One-click post direct debit bank charges, loan interest, and processing fees to reconcile book balance with statement balance.

steps.title: Reconciliation Completion Sign-Off
steps.content: Confirm 'Balance as per Books' perfectly reconciles with 'Balance as per Bank Passbook' and save the statement.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Generating General Ledger & Sub-Ledger Reports
lessons.description: Filter ledger statements by date range, voucher type, site code, and export to Excel/PDF.

steps.title: Open General Ledger Register
steps.content: Go to Accounting & Finance -> Ledger & Reports. Select the ledger account (e.g., 'Shree Cement', 'Petty Cash Site A').

steps.title: Apply Site and Date Filters
steps.content: Choose the fiscal quarter or custom date range. Filter by Site to view project-specific financial movements.

steps.title: Audit Running Balances & Drill-Down
steps.content: Review Opening Balance, Running Debits, Credits, and Closing Balance. Click any voucher row to inspect the source document.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: TDS Deduction, Section 194C / 194J & Challan 281 Filing
lessons.description: Reconcile monthly TDS withholdings from contractors and professionals, generate Challan 281, and prepare Form 26Q quarterly returns.

steps.title: Access Monthly TDS Register
steps.content: Navigate to Accounting & Finance -> TDS & GST. View deductions organized by Section 194C (Contractors) and 194J (Consultants).

steps.title: Verify PAN and Deduction Rates
steps.content: Confirm individual contractors are deducted at 1% (or company contractors at 2%). Check for non-PAN flags requiring 20% rate.

steps.title: Generate Challan 281 Payment Entry
steps.content: Generate the Challan 281 tax deposit voucher by the 7th of the following month with BSR Code and Challan Serial Number.

steps.title: Export Form 26Q e-TDS Return File
steps.content: Generate and download the NSDL-compliant Form 26Q quarterly return file for direct upload to TRACES portal.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: GST GSTR-1, GSTR-3B & E-Way Bill Reconciliation
lessons.description: Audit outward client supplies, match vendor invoices against GSTR-2B, and reconcile net monthly GST liability.

steps.title: Review Outward Supplies (GSTR-1)
steps.content: Open GST Compliance -> Outward Invoices. Verify all certified client invoices with correct HSN/SAC codes (9954 for civil construction).

steps.title: Reconcile Input Tax Credit (ITC) with GSTR-2B
steps.content: Cross-match purchase bills with the government 2B ledger to identify missing vendor invoices before claiming tax credit.

steps.title: Compute Net Monthly GSTR-3B Liability
steps.content: System automatically offsets eligible input credit against output liability and displays net cash tax payable.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Site-Wise Profit & Loss Statement (P&L)
lessons.description: Compare revenue certified against direct site costs (steel, cement, labor, fuel, equipment depreciation) for individual projects.

steps.title: Open Profit & Loss Report
steps.content: Navigate to Accounting & Finance -> Financial Statements -> Profit & Loss. Choose 'Site Cost-Center View'.

steps.title: Select Target Project / Site
steps.content: Filter by specific site location to isolate revenues, vendor material debits, and contractor payments for that project.

steps.title: Analyze Gross Site Margin & Net Profitability
steps.content: Review Certified Turnover vs Direct Site Cost (Steel, Cement, Subcontractor RA, Machinery). Check gross operating margins.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Trial Balance & Balance Sheet Preparation
lessons.description: Verify debit/credit balance integrity across all accounts and generate consolidated Balance Sheet reports.

steps.title: Generate Trial Balance
steps.content: Open Accounting & Finance -> Statements -> Trial Balance. Check that total debits match total credits across all heads.

steps.title: Verify Balance Sheet Classifications
steps.content: Switch to Balance Sheet. Review Current Assets (Bank, Cash, Site Stores, Retention Due) and Current Liabilities (Retention Payable, Sundry Creditors).

steps.title: Review Capital & Net Worth Position
steps.content: Inspect Reserves, Partner Capital Accounts, and Secured Construction Loans for the consolidated enterprise.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Financial Year-End Closing & Opening Balances Roll-Forward
lessons.description: Close profit & loss to retained earnings and roll forward ledger balances for the new fiscal year.

steps.title: Execute Year-End Accruals & Physical Audits
steps.content: Verify physical stock in all site stores, provision for retention receivables, and record audit fee accruals.

steps.title: Trigger Financial Year Roll-Forward
steps.content: Click 'Year-End Close'. System posts net P&L balance to Retained Earnings and carries forward all asset/liability balances into the new fiscal year.

lessons.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Exporting Accounting Reports to Excel/Tally/PDF
lessons.description: One-click export of daybook, cash registers, voucher listings, and audit trails.

steps.title: Select Export Options
steps.content: From any accounting screen or register, click the 'Export' button in the toolbar.

steps.title: Choose Format (Excel, PDF, Tally XML)
steps.content: Select Excel for audit analysis, formatted PDF with company header for print, or Tally XML for statutory auditor import.

faqs.question: How do I create a new project?
faqs.answer: Navigate to Organization -> Projects from the left sidebar and click '+ New Project'. Fill in the project name, client contract value, start date, target handover date, and assign a Project Manager. Click 'Save Record' to initialize the project workspace.

faqs.question: How to raise a material request from site?
faqs.answer: Open Procurement -> Material Requests (or click 'Requests' in the bottom navigation). Tap '+ New Request', choose your active site, pick required items (e.g. TMT Steel 16mm, Cement, Sand), enter required quantities, and submit for Purchase Officer approval.

faqs.question: How to create a purchase order?
faqs.answer: Go to Procurement -> Purchase Orders and click '+ New Order'. Select the verified vendor, reference approved material requisitions, verify unit rates and GST slabs, specify delivery site address, and click 'Create Purchase Order'.

faqs.question: How to generate a running bill?
faqs.answer: Navigate to Contractor & Billing -> Contractor Running Bills. Click '+ New Running Bill', select the subcontractor and work order. Enter measurement sheet quantities; the system automatically calculates gross value, 5% retention holdback, advance recovery, and net payable.

faqs.question: How to add a new user and give permissions?
faqs.answer: Go to Organization -> Users & Roles (Admin Only). Click '+ New User', enter employee name, email, and choose their role (e.g. Site Supervisor, Store Manager, Accountant). Role-based permissions are automatically enforced across the app.

faqs.question: How to take a backup of data?
faqs.answer: Open Settings -> System Backup. Click 'Export Snapshot (JSON)'. The ERP will compile all local site records, offline drafts, and preferences into a timestamped JSON file that can be archived or restored at any time.
